Classify InfluxDB query errors with bounded `error.type` values, and keep asynchronous and chunked spans and duration metrics open through internal processing and callbacks. HTTP-200 query errors use `_OTHER`; unsuccessful HTTP responses retain their status code in `error.type`.

Preserve callback parent context and distinguish intentional cancellation from user callback, transport, and decoder failures.

Builds on #20795's behavior-preserving lifecycle split.
